My grandfather, my hero, is dead now at last
So I must live for him. My heart is very sad.
He taught me right from wrong, so many things good,
In his own way he gave life its meaning true.
My grandmother walks as before every day,
She can no longer see or speak but she has faith.
"Good-bye dear child," said grandpa "the world belongs to thee."

and waited till he was quite gone; then she pushed off with him as they lay down the anchor. But when she got back from the deck where they had been chatting together, her husband was not there.
